registry_entry.title: Do Next Gen Stats passing numbers say something about a quarterback's next game that play-by-play does not?
registry_entry.question: Predict each qb_game's target from trailing values known before it. Three weighted least-squares fits with an intercept, weights = the game's dropbacks, fitted on qb_games in 2017-2021 and scored on qb_games in 2022-2023: base = [trailing_epa]; control = base + [trailing_cpoe]; candidate = control + the four trailing_ngs columns.
registry_entry.rule: PASS if candidate minus control MSE is below zero and the upper end of its 95% cluster-bootstrap interval (clusters = passer-season, n_resamples and seed from the protocol) is below zero. Otherwise FAIL, and Stage 6 asks nothing more of Next Gen Stats. Control minus base is reported, not decided.
registry_entry.freezes: The candidate and control fits (their coefficients, fitted on 2017-2021 only) are frozen by this step and used unchanged by N2 and N3.
